references.name: EDC
paper_locations: Section 4.1.1, separate target-alignment and self-canonicalization objectives
references.local_snapshot_state: git rev-parse HEAD matched recorded pin and git status --short was empty on 2026-10-21
observed: Extraction, relation definition and canonicalization are distinct stages.
The canonicalizer embeds relation definitions, retrieves candidates, and calls a contextual multiple-choice verifier with an unmatched option.
An exact relation-name lookup bypasses the verifier.
When canonicalization fails, enrich=True adds a definition; without enrichment it can return no canonicalized triple. The paper's target-alignment mode excludes unmatched triples.
references.adapt: Downstream definition retrieval plus contextual scientific comparison, retaining exact source-local workflow occurrences.
references.reject: Name equality as scientific equivalence, merging at extraction time, or dropping unmatched supported assay operations.
references.limit: General relational-triple evaluation does not establish genomics workflow fidelity or biochemical interface compatibility.

references.name: Intern-Atlas
paper_locations: Sections 3.1-3.3: construction separated from graph operators
Section 3.2: quoted evidence and edge typing
references.local_snapshot_state: git rev-parse HEAD matched recorded pin and git status --short was empty on 2026-10-21
observed: The public local builder describes paper/method entities and relations, not detailed protocol material states.
Candidate pairs are selected using method-name and title/abstract overlap.
infer_relations falls back to heuristic_relation when an LLM relation call fails.
heuristic_relation can assign extends from shared terminology; this is an exploratory heuristic rather than source entailment.
The local graph query layer is distinct from construction and exposes filtered edges and neighborhoods.
The documented local PDF page limit defaults to eight; that does not establish methods/supplement coverage.
references.adapt: Separate method-relation records, source evidence and query operators, preserving historical relations separately from shared workflow components.
references.reject: Importing the public local heuristic fallback as an admission rule, or treating this local builder as a replication of every validation control in the paper.
references.limit: The paper's evolution graph and released local builder do not provide a complete genomics protocol extraction contract.

references.name: W3C PROV-O
references.adapt: Distinguish a protocol plan from asserted activity provenance; attach evidence/provenance to extraction artifacts separately from biological material flow.
references.limit: Using a provenance type does not certify an event occurred; PROV-O leaves plan specifications to applications.

references.name: LabCompiler
references.code_inspection: No released implementation inspected in this audit; do not claim code reuse.
references.adapt: Distinguish semantic procedure representation from downstream execution normalization; preserve source correspondence and unresolved values.
references.reject: Treating 26 laboratory execution actions as an exhaustive vocabulary of genomics mechanisms, or silently repairing a published source into a different assay.
references.limit: An execution-oriented recovery benchmark is not validation of our source-faithful extraction or cross-method graph.
